description: HubSpot only: when the team's CRM isn't HubSpot, use crm-contact-lookup. Pulls a full view of one person from HubSpot — deal status, lifecycle stage, last interaction, notes, tasks, and associated company — as a summary in chat. Use on "pull up X", "show me X's record", "what's happening with X", "who is X", "what do we know about X", "when did we last contact X", "look up X", or a pasted email address, where X is a person. Not for a company (hubspot-account-brief) or a call or meeting (hubspot-call-prep).
